reason: The first SL1 stress case failed a relative-to-removed-mass tolerance even though the absolute discrepancy was 1.91e-12 represented persons. The aggregate prediction computes a small difference between large summed stocks while the implementation sums per-person removals directly, so normal floating-point cancellation is magnified when divided by a very small disrupted mass.

amended_rule.rationale: Scale numerical tolerance to the stock being summed rather than to a near-zero difference of large sums.

guard: This amendment only changes floating-point acceptance scaling. Any residual exceeding the stock-scaled tolerance still blocks promotion.
